# Spark Point Infotech — Digital Matter Synthesis & Software Engineering

> Spark Point Infotech is an international software engineering company building high-performance custom websites, web applications, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), UI/UX design systems, and ongoing system maintenance.
> Serving businesses across India, Germany, and The Netherlands.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Web Applications**: Business portals, SaaS platforms, customer dashboards, multi-tenant architectures, role-based permissions, and custom API backends.
- **Mobile App Development**: Single-codebase iOS & Android apps built for high performance, offline resilience, and native device feature integration.
- **High-Converting Websites**: Modern, responsive, SEO-optimized web platforms built with fast load speeds, CMS capabilities, and high conversion UX.
- **UI/UX Design Systems**: Figma-based component libraries, tokenized design systems, and interactive prototypes built before production coding begins.
- **Maintenance & Support**: Post-launch SLA monitoring, security patching, cloud infrastructure scaling, performance tuning, and 24/7 uptime oversight.

## Engagement Model & Fixed Guarantees

1. **Written Specification Lock**: Every project begins with a discovery phase resulting in a binding, detailed specification document.
2. **Guaranteed Fixed Pricing**: No hidden costs or surprise hourly billing. All deliverables have explicit upfront pricing.
3. **Dated Delivery Schedules**: Bi-weekly sprint milestones with staging previews to verify working software.
4. **Full IP & Source Code Transfer**: On day one of handover, complete repository source code access and operational runbooks are transferred to the client.

## Operating Regions & Target Sectors

- **Regions Served**: India, Germany, The Netherlands.
- **Key Sectors**: E-commerce & Retail, SaaS & Tech Startups, Healthcare & Medical Clinics, Manufacturing & Logistics.

## Technical Stack & Standards

- **Frontend**: HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Modern Vanilla JS, Vite, Three.js (3D WebGL Visualization), GSAP Animation Library.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS, Vercel.
- **Design Tools**: Figma Design Systems, Tokenized Design Architecture.
- **Compliance & Privacy**: Strict GDPR compliance, data encryption, and role-based security access control.
